Goes to `src/modules/kyc/interfaces/kyc-verification.ts`.

```ts
// Default location: src/modules/kyc/interfaces/kyc-verification.ts

export const KycDecision = { APPROVED: 'APPROVED', REJECTED: 'REJECTED', PENDING: 'PENDING' } as const;
export type KycDecision = (typeof KycDecision)[keyof typeof KycDecision];

/**
 * One identity check, in domain terms. Never log this object: it holds a document number and a selfie.
 * - idempotencyKey: generated by this service once per business operation and stored before the call (for example the
 *   id of the verification row the service inserted first), so every attempt and every later retry of the operation
 *   sends the same key and the provider applies it once. Never the inbound x-request-id or a client's Idempotency-Key.
 * - traceRef: a correlation value for the provider's logs and support (the request id is fine here); it deduplicates nothing.
 */
export type VerifyIdentityCommand = {
  readonly idempotencyKey: string;
  readonly traceRef: string;
  readonly documentNumber: string;
  readonly selfie: Buffer;
};

/** What the caller supplies on every run of an operation; the idempotency key comes from the stored operation row. */
export type KycEvidence = Pick<VerifyIdentityCommand, 'documentNumber' | 'selfie'>;

export type VerifyIdentityResult = {
  readonly decision: KycDecision;
  readonly score: number;
  readonly providerReference: string;
};
```
